findings.title: Oversized bed_id returns 500 on POST /api/waterings and GET /api/waterings?bed_id=
findings.steps: POST {"bed_id":99999999999999999999} to /api/waterings; or GET /api/waterings?bed_id=99999999999999999999; or DELETE /api/waterings/99999999999999999999
findings.evidence: curl returned 'Internal Server Error 500' for all three requests

findings.title: NaN / Infinity litres crash the server with 500
findings.actual: 500 Internal Server Error (the validation error with a non-finite input cannot be serialised)
findings.evidence: curl: 'Internal Server Error 500' for both; no row was inserted

findings.title: No retry on watering load errors (dashboard and waterings page)
findings.steps: Open the dashboard or /waterings while the API is down or GET /waterings fails
findings.expected: Error message with a Retry button that reloads the data in place once the server is back
findings.actual: Only an alert is shown, with no retry control. The dashboard doesn't even destructure refresh for waterings, so the only way to recover is a full reload
findings.evidence: index.vue: `const { data: waterings, error: wateringsError } = wateringsResult` and the AlertMessage has no button; waterings.vue AlertMessage has no retry

findings.title: Beds list failure on the waterings page goes unreported; the filter just shows 'All beds'
findings.steps: Open /waterings when GET /api/beds fails but /api/waterings succeeds
findings.expected: Visible error that the bed filter couldn't load, with a retry
findings.actual: The beds error is ignored (`const { data: beds } = bedsResult`). The select shows only 'All beds', as if no beds existed. With ?bed=N the select shows a blank value
findings.evidence: waterings.vue code: the bedsResult error is never read

findings.title: Watering requests have no timeout; 'Watering…'/'Saving…' can stay disabled forever
findings.where: /beds Water now and Record past watering, /waterings delete, dashboard
findings.steps: Make the API hang (accept the connection but never respond), then click Water now
findings.expected: Request fails after 10 s with a visible error and the button re-enables
findings.actual: useApiClient ($fetch.create) and useApiFetch set no timeout, so the button stays 'Watering…' and disabled indefinitely
findings.evidence: composables/useApi.ts has no timeout option; recordWatering awaits api() with no timeout

findings.title: Water now / past watering are not idempotent: a retry after a timeout or lost response records a duplicate
findings.steps: Click Water now. The server records it but the response is lost or errors. The page shows 'Could not record the watering.' and the user clicks again
findings.actual: Two waterings are recorded. There is no idempotency key or dedup. Repeated POSTs in the same second produced separate rows (ids 3 and 5, same timestamp)
findings.evidence: POST {bed_id:1} twice created ids 3 and 5, both at 2026-11-12 16:34:42

findings.title: A single shared 'busy' id lets a bed's Water now re-enable while its request is still pending
findings.steps: Click Water now on bed A, then quickly on bed B. When A finishes, its finally block sets wateringBedId=null while B is still pending. Click B again
findings.expected: B's button stays disabled until its request finishes, so only one watering is recorded
findings.actual: B's button is re-enabled early, so a second click records a duplicate watering. B's busy label also disappears
findings.evidence: beds.vue recordWatering: `wateringBedId.value = bed.id` ... `finally { wateringBedId.value = null }` with one shared ref

findings.title: Tiny litre amounts are accepted but shown as '0 L'
findings.steps: Record a past watering with litres 0.001 (the client allows any value > 0; the API accepts 1e-7)
findings.expected: Either refuse with a reason (e.g. minimum 0.1 L as the input's min suggests) or show the value
findings.actual: The row shows '0 L' and the success notice says 'Recorded 0 L on …'
findings.evidence: /waterings SSR HTML shows '12 Nov 2026, 17:34 North bed 0 L' for the litres=1e-7 entry

findings.title: Implausible past dates (year 0001) are accepted
findings.expected: Refused with a reason (no lower bound on the date)
findings.actual: Saved and listed as '1 Jan 1', at the bottom of the history
findings.evidence: API 201 for watered_on 0001-01-01; /waterings shows '1 Jan 1 North bed 5 L'

findings.title: Invalid ?bed= query shows a raw technical validation message
findings.steps: Open /waterings?bed=abc (e.g. an edited or stale link)
findings.expected: Friendly message or ignore the bad filter
findings.actual: Shows 'Query.bed id: Input should be a valid integer, unable to parse string as an integer'. The select is blank

findings.title: 'Today' is computed in different time zones on the client and server
findings.steps: Use a browser in a time zone ahead of the server (e.g. UTC+9 vs the server's CET) after the server's midnight is still pending, then save the default date (today)
findings.actual: The server's date.today() rejects it with 'Watering date cannot be in the future.' 'Water now' also stores watered_on in server-local time, which can differ from the viewer's date shown by watered_at
findings.evidence: schemas.py not_in_future uses server date.today(); the form default and max come from the browser's todayIso()

findings.title: Long unbroken bed names overflow the watering tables at 375 px
findings.steps: Create a bed named with 60 characters and no spaces, water it, and view /waterings at 375 px wide
findings.actual: The CSS has no overflow-wrap/word-break and the 4-column table has no scroll container. The bed name cell plus nowrap amount and Delete button push the table past the viewport
findings.evidence: main.css: no overflow-wrap anywhere; .table width 100% with no wrapping rules
